name: Dismantlable-Ample Relative Corner Threshold
definition: The minimum of $|A\setminus B|$ over nonempty proper inclusions $B\subsetneq A$ of dismantlable ample families for which every corner of $A$ lies in $B$. The value is $+\infty$ if no such pair exists.
normalization: The difference counts concepts; constant coordinates and displayed hypercube dimension do not affect the value.
comments: This is a class-level extremal threshold. It converts lower bounds for trapped dismantlable-ample intervals into lower bounds for cornerless ample families.
